masteryZone.q: Which particle is the heaviest among subatomic particles?
masteryZone.sol: The neutron is slightly heavier than the proton (1.675 x 10^-27 kg vs 1.672 x 10^-27 kg).

masteryZone.q: True or False: Cathode rays consist of positively charged particles.
masteryZone.sol: False. Cathode rays consist of negatively charged electrons.
J.J. Thomson discovered the electron in 1897.

masteryZone.q: Rutherford's gold foil experiment proved the presence of:
masteryZone.sol: It proved the presence of a tiny, dense, positively charged nucleus in the center of the atom.

masteryZone.q: True or False: In Bohr's model, electrons can revolve in any circular path of any radius.
masteryZone.sol: False. Electrons revolve only in certain quantized discrete orbits where they do not radiate energy.

masteryZone.q: Which isotope is used in treating Goitre?
masteryZone.sol: Iodine-131 is used to treat goitre (thyroid disorder).

masteryZone.q: True or False: Isobars have the same chemical properties.
masteryZone.sol: False. Isobars have different atomic numbers (different elements), so they have completely different chemical properties.

masteryZone.q: Which quantum number describes the shape of the orbital?
masteryZone.sol: The Azimuthal Quantum Number (l) determines the subshell shape (s, p, d, f).

masteryZone.q: True or False: The 3d orbital is filled before the 4s orbital according to Aufbau Principle.
masteryZone.sol: False. The 4s orbital is filled before 3d because it has a lower n+l value (4 vs 5).
